svg.title: The number s = 11CA/(24π2) is derived within the supplied construction: it is the exact coefficient of log L in the annular integral (DR5) of the pole (DR1). The reference clock bβi = ̄β + sti is a chosen comparison clock built from that number. The actual couplings are not asserted to equal the clock: they are produced by the committed path coefficient and the bounded reset, and are tied to the clock only through the inequality (DR7), which the shooting and running arguments below then calibrate. The lift transports αa as a scalar reader of the realized film (films are functions of gauge-invariant stationary data and of tagged frames, read on the identity-frame section), so N,i = αN,i, dZ = d and (DR7) is recovered with the same constant. No physical interpretation of αZ s beyond this calibration role is added.
